statement: Suppose λ > 0. At a generic point of the calibrated line one may take a further joint tangent in which the conditional parameter profile, referenced to zero at the center, is K(Y, R) = sY + θ(R − λY )+, 0 ≤ θ ≤ s/λ. (4.4) Consequently t ≥ s below the tie, while r ≥ θ and t ≥ s − λθ above it. The simultaneous parameter advance (Y, R) = (u, λu) has rate at least s. 45 Let Γ be the plane R = λY inside full alignment. If λ ̸= 1, the spatial partials can simultaneously be made singleton constants at generic points of Γ. There (4.3) holds with time subscript s, and also with tilt subscript θ when θ > 0.
